findings.Location: Product PRD §9 line 186 and §14.4 line 229; Risk Register §3 line 63; Open Questions OQ-001/OQ-003
findings.Source of truth: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI urgency GET/PUT/reset and employee search schemas; Stage 3.5 SCR-153 and SCR-133/134/135; candidate DEC-053–059
findings.Expected: Current PRD and risk register use one current OQ status. Superseded gap text is explicitly historical.
findings.Actual: §9 and the current risk section say OQ-001/OQ-003 remain High and block Stage 4.2; §14.4 and Open Questions say Fixed.
findings.Defect: The package simultaneously opens and closes both product-blocking OQ.
findings.Consequence: Approvers and implementation teams receive mutually exclusive normative instructions; the audit gate and feature scope are indeterminate.
findings.Recommended fix: Replace current blocking wording with explicit resolved history and one Fixed status linked to Stage 2.3.1/3.5 evidence.
findings.Verification: No current occurrence says remain High/block Stage 4.2/contract absent; every current status resolves to Fixed and the resolved-history chain remains.

findings.Location: Appendix P.2 lines 6792–6801; FR-159, FR-160, FR-243, FR-244, FR-260, FR-261, FR-265, FR-266, FR-269 and their mapped AC
findings.Source of truth: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 delta/flows; candidate Appendix P.2
findings.Expected: Each updated FR has AC that directly verifies its current formulation.
findings.Actual: Nine of ten updated FR retain legacy AC mappings. Examples: FR-243 employee group → AC-1404 safe route; FR-261 urgency projection → AC-1426 toast text alternative; FR-269 scale audit event → AC-1435 generic history.
findings.Defect: Formal FR→AC links exist but do not test the effective normative FR text.
findings.Consequence: The candidate can pass its AC suite while omitting updated OQ-001/OQ-003 behavior.
findings.Recommended fix: Consolidate each changed FR into its primary module row and remap/add atomic Gherkin AC for every new outcome.
findings.Verification: A semantic FR→AC review confirms that every mandatory outcome in each changed FR appears in observable Then/And steps.

findings.Location: MOD-014 field table line 4446 and embedded AC-070 line 4508; conflicting addendum lines 6814–6817 and 6862–6873
findings.Source of truth: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI query.types includes employee with maxItems=10; SearchSuggestion/EmployeeSearchResult; Stage 3.5 SCR-133/134/135 and FLOW-019
findings.Expected: The main module table contains employee/maxItems=10 and embedded AC-070 tests only BR-070 deprecation/replacement.
findings.Actual: MOD-014 still lists nine types without employee and maxItems=9; embedded AC-070 says employee is unsupported and remains an OQ. The later addendum says the opposite.
findings.Defect: One module contains two incompatible current search contracts.
findings.Consequence: Desktop and QA may legally implement and accept search without employees; OQ-003 is reopened.
findings.Recommended fix: Update the main MOD-014 field table and embedded AC-070 to match OpenAPI and the canonical AC catalog; mark old text historical.
findings.Verification: employee is present, maxItems=10, embedded/catalog AC-070 agree, and no current statement says employee is unsupported.

findings.Location: 211 rows with empty Gherkin: 96 BR-oriented and 115 FR-oriented; examples AC-001–069, AC-113, AC-128, AC-130, AC-1403–1435
findings.Source of truth: Stage 4.2 audit charter Part 7; linked FR/BR; Product PRD §10 test coverage gate
findings.Expected: Every AC contains Given, When and an observable, unambiguous Then.
findings.Actual: 211/1824 AC contain only a short Scenario title and a blank Gherkin field.
findings.Defect: The criteria repeat a rule or happy-path label without executable preconditions, action and result.
findings.Consequence: QA cannot derive deterministic tests; incompatible implementations can pass the same criterion.
findings.Recommended fix: Add atomic Gherkin for all 211, including role/capability, state/error, exact response/UI outcome and boundaries where applicable.
findings.Verification: 1824/1824 Gherkin cells are non-empty and contain Given/When/Then; manual spot-check confirms observable outcomes.

findings.Location: 466 AC without a direct FR reference: 112 BR-only and 354 DATA-only
findings.Related IDs: AC-001–097 with exceptions; AC-1436–1789; BR-*; DATA-001–021
findings.Source of truth: Stage 4.2 audit charter Part 7 requires each AC to link to an existing FR; catalog column is named FR/BR
findings.Expected: Every AC resolves to an effective FR, directly or through an explicit normalized relation.
findings.Actual: 466 AC have no FR token. DATA-only rows also violate the declared FR/BR column domain.
findings.Defect: The verification graph cannot mechanically demonstrate FR coverage for these AC.
findings.Consequence: AC counts overstate effective FR verification and make impact analysis unreliable.
findings.Recommended fix: Add direct FR links or a normalized AC↔requirement↔FR relation with validated transitive resolution.
findings.Verification: AC without resolvable FR=0; all intermediate requirement links exist and resolve deterministically.

findings.Location: 87 rows with empty AC: DATA-002/003/016; PERM-001–021; ERR-001–021; SYNC-001–021; AUDIT-001–021
findings.Source of truth: OpenAPI; permissions.csv; errors.csv; Stage 1 server-authoritative/sync/audit rules; Stage 3.5 state matrix
findings.Expected: Every row presented as a requirement has explicit verification criteria.
findings.Actual: 87 requirements have no AC link; related prose elsewhere does not provide requirement-level traceability.
findings.Defect: Cross-cutting requirements are orphaned from the verification ledger.
findings.Consequence: Permission, error, sync and audit regressions can escape module DoD.
findings.Recommended fix: Link each row to concrete AC or fold it into an FR/BR/NFR with explicit verification.
findings.Verification: Requirement rows with blank AC=0 and every link resolves to an AC that tests the stated behavior.

findings.Location: 96/113 BR have an empty Related FR field
findings.Related IDs: BR-001–097 except the explicitly related/deprecated subset
findings.Source of truth: Concept and current contract/UX sources for each module; Stage 4.2 audit charter Part 6
findings.Expected: Each BR identifies the FR scope to which it applies, including exceptions and priority.
findings.Actual: Module and Verification are present, but Related FR is blank for 96 BR.
findings.Defect: The BR↔FR applicability graph is missing.
findings.Consequence: A changed FR can silently violate a rule and one BR-level AC cannot prove application to all affected functions.
findings.Recommended fix: Populate a many-to-many BR↔FR mapping; formalize scope/exceptions for global rules.
findings.Verification: No unexplained empty Related FR; all links exist and rule priority is unambiguous.

findings.Location: 260 trace rows and 1305 AC source cells reference Stage_3_Field_Traceability.csv
findings.Source of truth: Actual Stage 3.5 file Stage_3_Field_Traceability_Final_3.5.csv and Stage 3.5 manifest
findings.Expected: Every source reference resolves to the exact canonical local file or to a declared manifest alias.
findings.Actual: The referenced filename does not exist and no alias is declared.
findings.Defect: Mass broken reference contradicts lost references=0.
findings.Consequence: Automated evidence resolution and manual review cannot open the claimed source.
findings.Recommended fix: Replace the old filename with the exact 3.5 filename or define and validate a formal alias.
findings.Verification: Old-name occurrences=0; link checker resolves every source path.

findings.Artifact: Stage 3.5 User Flows; candidate Decision Log, Traceability CSV and validation
findings.Location: Stage 3.5 User Flows has FLOW-035 at lines 537 and 879 and no FLOW-038; candidate has 17 trace rows with FLOW-038
findings.Source of truth: Stage 3.5 User Flows; audit rule forbidding PRD flow without an addressable UX flow
findings.Expected: FLOW-035 resolves only to project completion; FLOW-038 has an addressable downstream definition for urgency management.
findings.Actual: DEC-060 explains the alias, but the normative UX package still has two FLOW-035 definitions and no FLOW-038 definition.
findings.Defect: The semantic correction is not a resolvable cross-artifact trace target.
findings.Consequence: Automated trace treats FLOW-038 as unknown and designers must infer which FLOW-035 section is intended.
findings.Recommended fix: Add a downstream errata/alias artifact with a full FLOW-038 definition, without changing the Stage 3.5 source ZIP.
findings.Verification: Unique flow registry; all FLOW-035 references are project-only and FLOW-038 references urgency-only.

findings.Artifact: Requirements, BR, AC and NFR catalogs; Readiness artifact
findings.Location: Active sources: 20 FR, 81 BR trace rows, 81 BR catalog rows, 108 AC rows use Stage 3.4; NFR-012 uses Stage 2.2
findings.Related IDs: FR-242…269 subset; BR-016…097 subset; related AC; NFR-012
findings.Source of truth: Candidate Product PRD line 204 and CANONICAL_BASELINE.md: Stage 2.3.1/3.5 current; 2.2/3.4 historical only
findings.Expected: Active source fields cite current baselines; historical versions are explicitly qualified and secondary.
findings.Actual: Hundreds of active rows cite 3.4 or 2.2 as their operative source without historical qualification.
findings.Defect: The declared source hierarchy is not consistently applied.
findings.Consequence: Regeneration or design review can use stale 1040-row UX/241-operation contract semantics.
findings.Recommended fix: Revalidate and relink active rows to 3.5/2.3.1; retain old versions only as marked provenance.
findings.Verification: No active source cell uses 2.2/3.4 without explicit historical/superseded qualification and current replacement.

findings.Location: NFR-024 and OQ-008; measurement gaps in NFR-001/003/006/007/015
findings.Source of truth: Architecture §0.5; candidate Open Questions OQ-008; Stage 4.2 NFR measurement gate
findings.Expected: Every NFR has an objective pass threshold or is explicitly provisional/unverified.
findings.Actual: NFR-024 says availability/RPO/RTO must be measured and confirmed, while OQ-008 remains open; several other targets use undefined terms such as approved/stable/critical.
findings.Defect: The catalog contains at least one explicit provisional/unverified NFR despite candidate claims of zero.
findings.Consequence: 100% readiness and a final NFR pass cannot be reproduced.
findings.Recommended fix: Mark NFR-024 provisional until OQ-008 closes and define objective policies/thresholds for the listed NFR.
findings.Verification: Every NFR has reproducible pass/fail criteria; provisional/unverified ledger accurately reports outstanding decisions.

findings.Expected: Each risk has probability, impact, owner, trigger, mitigation, verification and status.
findings.Actual: All 25 lack probability, owner and trigger; RISK-022–025 also lack a separate impact field; older risks repeat generic mitigation.
findings.Defect: The file is a topic list, not an operable risk register.
findings.Consequence: Material privacy, privilege, data-loss and concurrency risks cannot be owned, monitored or closed.
findings.Recommended fix: Extend the schema and populate probability, impact, owner role, trigger, preventive/contingency actions, verification and status.
findings.Verification: Risk lint confirms all required fields are non-empty and closure evidence is traceable.

findings.Artifact: NFR catalog; AC catalog; Module PRDs
findings.Location: NFR-002–005; AC-1805/1807/1815; target CMP accessibility sections
findings.Source of truth: Stage 3.5 UX Architecture active-descendant/Up/Down/Enter/Esc semantics and adaptive desktop layout rules
findings.Expected: Atomic AC cover exact keyboard/focus behavior and adaptive window resizing for CMP-001/CMP-002.
findings.Actual: General NFR exist, but no atomic AC covers active descendant, Up/Down, normal Esc focus return, CMP-001 tab order, or below-1100 logical-pixel adaptation.
findings.Defect: Published UX interactions are not fully transferred into the PRD verification matrix.
findings.Consequence: Desktop implementations can diverge and remain inaccessible or clipped while satisfying broad NFR wording.
findings.Recommended fix: Add exact keyboard/UIA/focus and resize AC for both components.
findings.Verification: Keyboard-only and resize matrix passes Tab/Shift+Tab/arrows/Enter/Esc, focus return, minimum window and 200% scaling.

findings.Location: Product PRD line 191; Readiness lines 107 and 127
findings.Actual: Current-looking sections retain 241/241 or all 241 while later sections say 244.
findings.Defect: The release gate has incompatible API totals.
findings.Consequence: A three-operation regression can still satisfy the stale DoD.
findings.Recommended fix: Update or clearly supersede all active 241-operation gates.
findings.Verification: No current count uses 241; independently parsed operationId count and coverage both equal 244.

findings.Actual: Nine AC use the undefined word корректно.
findings.Defect: A local test oracle is ambiguous.
findings.Recommended fix: Replace each occurrence with an exact state/value/ordering/error outcome.
findings.Verification: Undefined-term scan=0 and each affected Then is objectively assertable.

findings.Source of truth: Candidate privacy/minimization requirements and Product+Security ownership of OQ-010
findings.Expected: Production retention, access, rotation/deletion and storage boundary are approved.
findings.Actual: Retention remains open and temporary structured-log storage is allowed, although payload minimization is well specified.
findings.Consequence: Operational metadata may be retained longer or more broadly than necessary.
findings.Recommended fix: Close OQ-010 with an explicit storage/access/retention/rotation/deletion policy before production.
findings.Verification: Policy/config tests confirm retention and access while event allowlists and PII bans remain.
